530901.name: Laser Shower
530901.description: Fires a laser beam, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

530902.name: Ultrasonic Wave
530902.description: Emits an ultrasonic wave, granting buffs that cannot be removed to all summoned Raptures. If its core is destroyed, it will be not able to emit the wave.

530903.name: Hurtle
530903.description: Rushes recklessly, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

530904.name: Launch Massive Missiles
530904.description: Launches a volley of missiles from its side containers. The missiles can be intercepted. Any Nikke who is hit will have her DEF reduced. This effect can stack.

530906.name: Launch Master-Class Raptures
530906.description:
Launches Master-class Raptures from its central container.
Raptures will launch a simultaneous attack at a specific time.

530907.name: Launch Raptures
530907.description:
Launches Raptures from its side containers. Mother Whale's ATK increases according to the number of remaining Raptures.
Generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while these Raptures are alive. While the barrier is up, only Electric Code Nikkes can deal damage. This code barrier is only generated once per battle.
